$comment: Reusable clasp host script IDs, keyed by container type, owned once (docs/test-harness-design.md §4.1). scripts/push-demo.sh looks up demo.config.json's `host` field here to find the scriptId to push to. One demo lives per host at a time -- pushing overwrites the host's prior content. Populate scriptIds as hosts are provisioned (tracked by GAS-Core-pos.2); empty/missing entries cause push-demo.sh to fail with a clear message rather than push to script id "".
